WITH record_shares AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    1.0 * traitcount / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin
  FROM record_shares
)
SELECT
  zoneref AS site_code,
  traitcount AS feature_count,
  share,
  margin
FROM scored
WHERE margin > 0
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;
